# Dzen
> Dzen is a Russian content platform for articles, videos, posts, channels, and personalized media discovery.

Dzen combines a recommendation feed with publishing tools for creators, channel pages, media collections, and account management. The platform also includes help materials, legal information, and app distribution pages.

## Main Platform
- [Home](https://dzen.ru/): Main personalized feed for discovering articles, videos, and creator content.
- [Video](https://dzen.ru/video): Video discovery section with clips, shows, and creator channels.
- [Shorts](https://dzen.ru/shorts): Short-form vertical video feed for quick mobile-friendly viewing.
- [Live](https://dzen.ru/live): Live streaming section for real-time broadcasts and events.
- [Topics](https://dzen.ru/topic): Topic-based discovery hub for browsing content categories.
- [Search](https://dzen.ru/search): Search interface for finding channels, authors, and publications.

## For Readers
- [Feed](https://dzen.ru/): Personalized recommendation stream based on interests and engagement.
- [Subscriptions](https://dzen.ru/subscriptions): Aggregated feed of channels and authors a user follows.
- [Bookmarks](https://dzen.ru/bookmarks): Saved publications and videos for later reading or viewing.
- [History](https://dzen.ru/history): Recently viewed content and interaction history for the account.
- [Profile](https://dzen.ru/profile): User profile area with activity, settings, and personal content.
- [Notifications](https://dzen.ru/notifications): Alerts about subscriptions, comments, and platform activity.

## For Creators
- [Studio](https://studio.dzen.ru/): Creator dashboard for publishing, analytics, and channel management.
- [Channel Setup](https://studio.dzen.ru/channel): Channel configuration, branding, and public presentation settings.
- [Publications](https://studio.dzen.ru/publications): Content management area for articles, posts, and videos.
- [Analytics](https://studio.dzen.ru/analytics): Performance metrics for views, audience, and engagement.
- [Monetization](https://studio.dzen.ru/monetization): Earnings and monetization tools for eligible creators.
- [Comments](https://studio.dzen.ru/comments): Moderation interface for audience comments and discussions.

## Publishing Tools
- [Create Article](https://studio.dzen.ru/editor): Editor for long-form articles with media and formatting tools.
- [Create Post](https://studio.dzen.ru/posts): Publishing workflow for short posts and updates.
- [Upload Video](https://studio.dzen.ru/videos): Video upload and management interface for creators.
- [Drafts](https://studio.dzen.ru/drafts): Unpublished and in-progress content saved in the studio.
- [Scheduled Publications](https://studio.dzen.ru/scheduled): Queue for planned future content releases.
- [Media Library](https://studio.dzen.ru/media): Asset storage for images, video, and reusable media files.

## Help & Support
- [Help Center](https://help.dzen.ru/): Official support portal with platform guidance and troubleshooting.
- [For Authors Help](https://help.dzen.ru/authors/): Help materials focused on publishing and channel management.
- [For Readers Help](https://help.dzen.ru/readers/): Support articles for consuming content and using the feed.
- [Monetization Help](https://help.dzen.ru/monetization/): Guidance on eligibility, payouts, and creator earnings.
- [Mobile App Help](https://help.dzen.ru/app/): Support information for using Dzen on mobile devices.
- [Contact Support](https://help.dzen.ru/feedback): Support request and feedback submission entry point.

## Mobile Apps
- [Android on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ru.zen.android): Android app listing for reading, watching, and publishing on Dzen.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/%D0%B4%D0%B7%D0%B5%D0%BD/id553266486): iOS app listing for the Dzen mobile application.
- [AppGallery](https://appgallery.huawei.com/#/app/C100848977): Huawei AppGallery listing for the Dzen mobile app.
- [Mobile Web](https://dzen.ru/mobile): Mobile-oriented web experience for phones and tablets.

## Legal & Policies
- [Terms of Use](https://dzen.ru/legal): Core legal terms governing use of the Dzen platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dzen.ru/legal/confidential): Privacy and personal data processing policy.
- [User Agreement](https://dzen.ru/legal/rules): Rules and obligations for platform participants and users.
- [Recommendation Technologies](https://dzen.ru/legal/recommendation): Information about recommendation and ranking technologies.
- [Copyright Policy](https://dzen.ru/legal/copyright): Rights holder and copyright complaint procedures.
- [Advertising Documents](https://dzen.ru/legal/ads): Legal materials related to advertising on the platform.

- [About Dzen](https://dzen.ru/about): Overview of the platform, product positioning, and audience.
- [For Business](https://dzen.ru/business): Information for brands, advertisers, and business partners.
- [Advertising](https://dzen.ru/adv): Advertising solutions and campaign opportunities on Dzen.
- [Press](https://dzen.ru/press): Press materials, announcements, and media information.
